judge: fresh-context backend correctness and inline parsimony
scope: Engineering preview imported-media persistence, rendering, queue, HTTP/CLI boundaries; future MVP/V1 release gates excluded
checksPerformed: Verified frozen initial.diff SHA256 and scoped new-file sections for core/*.ts, server/*.ts, cli/main.ts and tests/*.ts; read their implementation and tests.
Read docs/PRODUCT.md and docs/RELEASE.md; inspected README and UI disclosures only to clarify imported video audio policy.
Executed rtk proxy node --test tests/core.test.ts tests/http.test.ts from work/Darzain: 7 tests passed, 0 failed; real FFmpeg image/audio/title export and HTTP restart covered.
Executed rtk proxy node work/evidence/review/backend-repro.mjs: real title export returned render.mp4 and artifactExists=true while signalAborted=true.

Executed rtk proxy node work/evidence/review/backend-close-repro.mjs: deferred load resumed after close and submit returned QUEUED; job subsequently executed and FAILED on the intentionally empty timeline.

findings.issue: Cancellation accepted during final path resolution or rename is lost: the renderer checks the signal before asynchronous publication and returns success afterward, so the queue marks the cancelled running job COMPLETED.
findings.reproduction: Run backend-repro.mjs. It builds a real one-second title-only project and wraps store.file to abort when the final render.mp4 destination is resolved. The original renderer returned an existing artifact despite signalAborted=true.
findings.fix: Recheck cancellation after publication awaits, delete a published artifact when cancelling at that boundary, and check the controller before setting COMPLETED so cancelled jobs cannot expose an artifact. Add a regression that aborts during destination resolution/publication.

findings.issue: close() does not stop admission: submit awaiting store.load can enqueue after close has returned, and the HTTP server continues accepting requests until after queue.close finishes. Shutdown can exit with newly started export work unawaited.
findings.reproduction: Run backend-close-repro.mjs. Hold load unresolved, invoke submit, await queue.close, then resolve load. submit succeeds with QUEUED and its render executes after closure.
findings.fix: Set a closing flag synchronously and reject submissions both before and after the load await; stop HTTP admission before draining the queue. Test deferred-load submission overlapping close.

correctnessClean: Same-store revision serialization rejects concurrent overwrites; imported asset metadata stays immutable and reads check hashes.
Source ranges, dimensions, references and schema versions are validated; render uses argument arrays and title text files with expansion disabled.
Sequential queue/idempotency behavior and queued cancellation pass existing tests.
Authenticated local HTTP calls and persisted project reopening pass the restart test.

parsimony.reason: Small schema/store/renderer/API layers directly serve this preview; no concrete unnecessary abstraction merits a finding.

limits: Did not independently compare decoded title pixels/audio waveforms; existing tests prove real export plus stream verification but only assert file size for its content.
Imported video sound requires a separate audio asset per the explicit UI disclosure, so its omission from the render mix is not a defect in this scope.
Durable jobs, portable/recoverable projects, generation, production packaging and other explicit future release gates are not must-fixes for this preview.
